title: Every Space theme with Spotlight layouts draws one page in the editor and on the link, and the owner can pick any of its six looks

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-06: fan out and make sure all the Spotlight themes are synced and selectable.

detail: spotlight.look (any of stack, card-wall, story, calendar-first, shop-front, profile) is stored on the Space and picked in the console Look section. ThemedSpaceSpotlight draws New World, Services, Network, Designer, Temple, Free Human and CyberWitch Spaces from the Space's own links, button, photo and tagline; the public page and the console preview both draw it. Nocturne, Bold and Wildheart have no whole-page layouts yet, so they keep the block page and show no picker. No migration.

verify.evidence: On a Space per theme, open /spaces/<slug>/manage/spotlight and /spaces/<slug>/spotlight: same page; pick each look and the preview and link follow. Closed on the owner's ruling, 2026-11-09 19:17Z. Asked how to close the shipped-pending-check rows, Daniel answered "b": close them without a production check. Any code for it that merged keeps its unit pins in CI. No production look was taken.
